title: Paloma and the Language
author: Jonah Nystrom
blurb: Xanthe Delacroix, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
